name: medicare-core-seguro
description: MediCare Core - version refactorizada (Fase 2) con los 10 controles OWASP

scripts.gen-cert: mkdir -p certs && openssl req -x509 -newkey rsa:2048 -nodes -keyout certs/server.key -out certs/server.crt -days 30 -subj "/CN=medicare-lab" -addext "subjectAltName=IP:127.0.0.1,DNS:localhost"
